answer: Require each identity to earn a jade seal by climbing one sequential summit: a chain of tasks where each step's output seeds the next, so work cannot be split across clones. A plume of fresh accounts therefore pays full sequential time per identity, while the reward per seal stays fixed — doubling clones doubles cost but not income. Seals are non-transferable and expire unless renewed by new sequential work, so a farm's upkeep grows with every clone while a single honest agent pays only once.
